method: quote text as written judged against claim; textual entailment only, no estate re-read (byte-check is tier 2)

rows.claim: The 2026 export-control channel binds China access and frontier volume, never a one-box US estate, so the estate's live sovereignty threat is model-weight licensing rather than chip law, and needs-less models hedge exactly that channel.
rows.quote: ECCN 3A090.a country licensing remains (RTX 4090 still restricted to China)
rows.reason: Quote states only a chip-law fact (ECCN 3A090.a country licensing; RTX 4090 China-restricted). It carries no frontier-volume conjunct, no 'never a one-box US estate' conjunct, no model-weight-licensing-as-live-threat conjunct, and nothing on needs-less models hedging. A chip-law licensing note cannot entail the claim whose conclusion is that chip law is NOT the live threat.

rows.claim: Every SpikingBrain headline shrank on primary reading (100x TTFT is 26.5x measured at 1M on 32 H100s and 2.4-3.7x at estate-scale 128k; 97 percent energy is per-MAC arithmetic on silicon whose LLM SOTA is 370M params), so adoption math must come from the paper's tables, never the tweet.
rows.quote: "100x faster than current LLMs": OVERSTATED by dropping the qualifier.
rows.reason: Quote asserts only that the '100x faster than current LLMs' headline is overstated by dropping a qualifier. It contains none of the claim's measured numbers (26.5x at 1M on 32 H100s; 2.4-3.7x at 128k), nothing on 97 percent per-MAC energy, nothing on 370M-param LLM SOTA silicon, and cannot carry the universal 'EVERY headline shrank' or the paper-tables-vs-tweet conclusion. One overstated-headline note does not entail the compound claim.

rows.claim: Convert-don't-train is the real sovereignty steal (existing open weights to hybrid-linear on about 2 percent of the data), but it prices at cluster class (150B tokens, roughly 579 consumer-GPU-days derived), so the estate prices probes before attempts and no-gos cluster recipes.
rows.reason: Quote names only the Qwen2.5-7B to hybrid-linear continued-training conversion. It carries no ~2 percent data fraction, no 150B tokens, no ~579 consumer-GPU-days figure, and nothing on pricing probes before attempts or no-going cluster recipes. 'Via continued training' also does not entail the claim's 'convert-don't-train' framing.

rows.claim: At estate scale, measured energy moves come from quantization (bytes) and serving knobs (power cap, frequency) at 1.3-5x today, while architecture change moves energy only through the long-context door, and model SIZE is the strongest lever of all.
rows.quote: small models are the whole game
rows.reason: Quote is a four-word assertion. It says nothing about quantization/bytes, serving knobs (power cap, frequency), the 1.3-5x measured range, or architecture change moving energy only through the long-context door. At most it loosely gestures at the size-lever conjunct, which alone cannot entail the compound claim.

rows.claim: The estate independently converged on the neuromorphic shape at the system level (event trigger, sparse delta processing, quiescence-gated compute), so the brain-inspired turn adds exactly one code port and zero silicon.
rows.quote: C1 only-thinks-when-triggered (boot-trigger law + dirty-block law + board_quiescent organ gate vs event-driven spiking, SpikingBrain 69.15 pct sparsity, Loihi 2 async)
rows.reason: Quote juxtaposes estate mechanisms (C1 only-thinks-when-triggered; boot-trigger law; dirty-block law; board_quiescent organ gate) against event-driven spiking, SpikingBrain 69.15 pct sparsity, and Loihi 2 async. The mapping suggests shape convergence but never states 'independently', never states the 'exactly one code port and zero silicon' conclusion, and its own Loihi 2 reference is silicon hardware the claim says is not needed. Entailment of the conclusion is absent.
